BUDGET-SIZED DOWN to fit ~20min train+score on a 24GB Q6000/Q5000: lpd_iters=5 (small unroll vs Adler I=10), hidden=48, epochs=6, train_n=200, batch=1; val_n=214 at val_chunk=1 (Mayo per-sample-ps swaps model.R per slice -> chunk must be 1). lr=5e-4 is a stable trained point well clear of the prior-run anomalous collapse at lr~6e-4. learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0005, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=10, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-2 search-20260619-01: SINGLE coupled knob = trade unroll depth for epochs. iter-1 (lpd_iters=5, epochs=6) scored SSIM 0.84271 / hr 0.000 in 1149.5s = 19.2min, i.e. AT the 20-min wall with hr stuck at the LD-FBP floor (budget-limited unrolled net, under-trained). No headroom to raise epochs alone. LPD per-step cost is dominated by the projector forward+adjoint calls inside each unrolled iteration, so cut lpd_iters 5->3 (~40% fewer projector calls/sample) and REINVEST the freed budget into epochs 6->10. Everything else held EXACTLY at iter-1 (hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=5e-4 cosine, train_n=200, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). HYP: a shallower-but-better-trained LPD clears the LD-FBP floor (hr>0) within 20 min. FALSIFIER: hr stays 0.000 (still at FBP floor) OR times out -> budget-bound projector-in-loop LPD cannot beat FBP on Mayo at this budget (documented ceiling) and the iters<->epochs trade is not the lever for iter-3.

column13: learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0005, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=11, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-3 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = epochs 10->11 (everything else held EXACTLY at iter-2: lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=5e-4 cosine, train_n=200, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). LIMITER = under-trained, NOT capacity-limited: iter-1 (iters5/ep6) SSIM 0.84271 hr0.000 in 1149.5s=19.16min; iter-2 (iters3/ep10) SSIM 0.863635 hr0.000 in 1079.3s=17.99min. The +0.021 SSIM from +4 epochs (with the depth cut) proves the net is still climbing the training curve, so epochs is the lever; hr still pinned at the LD-FBP floor (0.000) but RMSE flat (0.001721->0.001781). BUDGET MATH vs 20-min wall (1200s): iter-2 ran 1079.3s at 10 epochs => marginal epoch cost <=107.9s/epoch (over-attributing ALL of iter-2 incl. the fixed 214-slice val pass to epochs). epochs 10->11 worst-case = 1079.3 + 107.9 = 1187s = 19.8min < 1200s, fits with margin (true marginal cost is lower since val overhead is non-trivially folded into that bound). Could NOT safely push to 12 (worst-case 1295s=21.6min > 20-min budget). lpd_hidden^ or lpd_iters^ both ADD per-sample projector cost and would blow the wall (iter-1 at iters=5 already hit 19.16min). HYP: one more epoch lifts SSIM monotonically (predict ~0.866-0.870) and, if the climb is steep enough, clears the LD-FBP floor (hr>0). FALSIFIER: SSIM flat/down vs 0.863635 OR hr still 0.000 => epochs is saturating in this 20-min budget and a budget-bound projector-in-loop LPD cannot clear FBP on 2304-view Mayo at this capacity (documented ceiling); next iter would need capacity (hidden^) traded against a deeper budget, not more epochs.

learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=10, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-4 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = lr 5e-4 -> 7e-4 (everything else held at iter-2's BUDGET-COMPLIANT point: lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, cosine, epochs=10, train_n=200, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). LIMITER = now WALL-LIMITED on epochs, NOT capacity. SSIM is still climbing on epochs (iter-1 iters5/ep6 0.84271 @1149.5s; iter-2 iters3/ep10 0.863635 @1079.3s=17.99min; iter-3 iters3/ep11 0.885115 @1213.6s=20.23min) BUT iter-3 OVERSHOT the HARD 1200s/20-min budget: true marginal epoch cost = 1213.6-1079.3 = 134.3 s/epoch (higher than iter-3's 107.9s estimate), so ep12 would land ~1348s=22.5min, well over the wall. Epochs cannot go up. Per the no-trade-epochs-for-capacity rule, lpd_hidden^ and lpd_iters^ are also OFF (both add per-sample projector fwd+adj cost and blow the wall; iter-1 at iters=5 already hit 19.16min). The remaining wall-NEUTRAL lever is lr: at the budget-capped epoch count, a higher lr lets the cosine schedule traverse more of the loss landscape per epoch, extracting more training progress WITHOUT buying epochs or capacity. lr 7e-4 (NOT 6e-4: the prior run flagged lr~6e-4 as an ANOMALOUS COLLAPSE point; 7e-4 was a stable trained 0.9638 point) is the safe lr-up step. Epochs set back to 10 (iter-2's count, ran 1079.3s=18.0min, safely inside 1200s) to RESTORE the budget margin iter-3 broke. BUDGET MATH vs 1200s: iter-2 ran 1079.3s at ep10 -> iter-4 at the same ep10 + lr-only change is compute-identical (lr does not change FLOPs) => ~1079s=18.0min, well inside the 20-min wall. HYP: at the budget-capped ep10, lr 7e-4 extracts more SSIM per epoch than 5e-4 (faster cosine traversal), lifting SSIM toward clearing the LD-FBP floor (hr>0); predict ~0.87-0.89. FALSIFIER: SSIM <= 0.885115 (iter-3) OR flat/down with hr still 0.000 => LPD has hit its budget-constrained ceiling on 2304-view Mayo (~0.885 SSIM, hr 0); neither epochs (wall-capped) nor lr is the lever -> projector-in-loop LPD is structurally FBP-bounded at this capacity/budget (documented ceiling), and iter-5 would need a deeper wall, not more of this budget.

learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=3, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=7, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=300, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-5 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = train_n 200 -> 300 (the ONLY untried lever on LPD's Mayo arc). Everything physics/capacity held at iter-4's budget-compliant best-SSIM point (lpd_iters=3, hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, lr=7e-4 cosine, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42); epochs traded 10 -> 7 PURELY to hold the HARD 20-min wall (see budget math). WHY DATA IS NOT INERT: the LPD solver loads a FIXED train_n subset ONCE via build_dataset->load_val_split (solver L81), then torch.randperm reshuffles that SAME fixed tensor each epoch (solver L257). There is NO per-epoch RotatingSubsetDataset rotation in this solver path, so train_n=200 has only ever shown the net 200 distinct slices out of the 579-slice train pool (3 patients: ps-groups 154/98/327). At Mayo train_n the loader stratifies round-robin across the 3 ps-groups, so 200->300 adds ~100 genuinely-new distinct slices spanning all 3 train patients (group-2 caps at 98) => +50% effective training set, still patient-balanced. LIMITER REFRAME: the SSIM 0.843->0.864->0.885->0.898 arc was driven by epochs (under-training), then lr (iter-4), with hr pinned at the LD-FBP floor (0.000) the WHOLE way; epochs is now wall-capped and lr is spent, but the net has NEVER seen more than 200/579 slices. Data-coverage is the unexamined axis. BUDGET MATH vs 1200s/20-min wall: total job time scales with total gradient steps = epochs*train_n (batch=1) + a small fixed ~95s (cuda init + the fixed 214-slice val pass). iter-4 = 2000 steps (ep10*tn200) ran 1100.7s=18.35min => conservative 0.503 s/step. iter-5 = 2100 steps (ep7*tn300) -> model 1151s=19.18min, +49s margin under the 1200s wall (ep8*tn300=2400 steps=21.7min OVERshoots; ep7 is the budget-fit epoch count for tn300). lpd_hidden^/lpd_iters^ stay OFF (add per-sample projector fwd+adj cost, blow the wall). HYP: +50% distinct (still patient-balanced) training data lets the LPD generalise to the held-out val patient L277 better than 200 slices did, lifting SSIM (predict ~0.90-0.92) and, if the extra coverage adds real high-frequency structure the 200-slice net was missing, pushing RMSE down enough to clear the LD-FBP floor (hr>0) for the first time on LPD's Mayo arc. FALSIFIER: SSIM plateaus at/below 0.898 (iter-4) AND hr still 0.000 => more data is NOT the lever; LPD is at its budget-constrained ceiling on 2304-view Mayo (~0.90 SSIM, hr 0) -- a projector-in-loop unrolled net that sharpens structure (rising SSIM) but cannot beat FBP on PSNR/RMSE within the 20-min budget at this capacity. The epochs-down-to-7 confound is bounded: if SSIM DROPS below iter-2's 0.864 (ep10/tn200) the cut went too far and tn300 needs a deeper wall, not this budget.

learned_primal_dual-claude-agentic: lpd_iters=5, lpd_hidden=48, lpd_n_primal=5, lpd_n_dual=5, lpd_share_weights=False, lr=0.0007, lr_schedule=cosine, epochs=6, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-6 search-20260619-01: ONE knob = lpd_iters 3 -> 5 (UNROLL DEPTH), the LPD-DEFINING lever and the only remaining axis that directly tests the structural hypothesis. BASE_ITER=4 (best-SSIM config: lr=7e-4 cosine, lpd_hidden=48, n_primal=5, n_dual=5, batch=1, val_chunk=1, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). PRIOR ARC (ALL hr=0): SSIM 0.84271(it1 iters5/ep6/lr5e-4) -> 0.863635(it2) -> 0.885115(it3) -> 0.898033(it4 BEST, iters3/ep10/lr7e-4) -> 0.88446(it5 train_n300/ep7, epochs-cut-confounded but LOWEST RMSE 1.139e-3 yet STILL hr0). hr pinned at the LD-FBP floor the ENTIRE arc. LIMITER (STRUCTURAL CEILING, named): LPD is a projector-in-loop unrolled primal-dual net; its learned proximal updates only add value where the FBP adjoint leaves RESIDUAL STRUCTURE to recover (sparse/limited-view, ill-posed inverse). On DENSE 2304-view Mayo the LD-FBP is NEAR-COMPLETE (2304 views >> Nyquist; well-conditioned operator), so there is NO ill-posedness headroom for the unrolled updates to exploit -> LPD sharpens structure (rising SSIM) but cannot push RMSE below the already-near-optimal LD-FBP -> hr=0 regardless of capacity/epochs/lr/data. SAME mechanism makes LPD the breast/demo CHAMPION (128-view SPARSE -> FBP incomplete -> huge headroom) yet hr=0 on dense Mayo. iter-5 already FALSIFIED the data lever (train_n 200->300 fell to 0.88446). REMAINING UNTRIED AXIS = unroll DEPTH itself: lpd_iters 3->5 doubles-ish the learned primal-dual correction steps. If Mayo had ANY FBP-incompleteness headroom, deeper unrolling (the thing that makes LPD an unrolled net, not a U-Net) is exactly where it would surface. BUDGET MATH vs 1200s: iters=5 raises per-sample projector fwd+adj cost ~5/3x vs iters=3, so epochs traded 10->6 AND train_n 300->200 to hold the wall. EMPIRICALLY CONFIRMED FIT: iter-1 ran iters5/ep6/tn200 = 1149.5s = 19.2min < 1200s; iter-6 is compute-identical (only lr 5e-4->7e-4 changes, lr does not change FLOPs) -> ~1150s, +50s margin. ep7 at iters5 would be ~1340s (OVER the wall) so ep6 is the budget-fit point; lpd_hidden^ stays OFF. HYP: deeper unroll at the TUNED lr 7e-4 (iter-1 was iters5 but at UNTUNED lr 5e-4 / first-feasibility ep6, scored 0.84271) extracts more FBP-residual correction; predict SSIM ~0.86-0.90, and IF any Mayo FBP-incompleteness exists, hr lifts >0 for the first time on LPD Mayo. FALSIFIER: hr stays 0.000 (and SSIM <= 0.898 since ep6 under-trains vs iter-4 ep10) => deeper unrolling does NOT help => DEFINITIVE structural ceiling: dense 2304-view LD-FBP is near-complete, LPD has no ill-posedness to exploit, FBP-bounded regardless of unroll depth. The path now DOCUMENTS the ceiling toward iter-20.
